#| include: false

# Violin plot + pairwise Mann-Whitney heatmap inset, shared by the generation-probability
# plots (template_sample.qmd) and the TCRdist3 distance plots (_patient_clustering.qmd).
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

def _pairwise_significance_matrix(data, x_col, value_col, categories):
    """Pairwise Mann-Whitney U significance between categories of `x_col`,
    comparing `value_col`. Groups once instead of re-filtering the full
    dataframe for every (i, j) pair, which matters once `data` has many rows.
    Shared by create_pgen_tabs and create_distance_tabs_with_heatmap."""
    groups = {cat: vals for cat, vals in data.groupby(x_col)[value_col]}
    n = len(categories)
    p_matrix = np.full((n, n), np.nan)
    text_matrix = np.full((n, n), "", dtype=object)

    for i, c1 in enumerate(categories):
        g1 = groups.get(c1)
        if g1 is None or len(g1) < 2:
            continue
        for j, c2 in enumerate(categories):
            if i <= j:
                continue
            g2 = groups.get(c2)
            if g2 is None or len(g2) < 2:
                continue
            try:
                _, p = mannwhitneyu(g1, g2, alternative='two-sided')
            except ValueError:
                continue
            p_matrix[i, j] = -np.log10(p + 1e-300)
            if p < 0.0001: star = "****"
            elif p < 0.001: star = "***"
            elif p < 0.01: star = "**"
            elif p < 0.05: star = "*"
            else: star = ""
            text_matrix[i, j] = star

    return p_matrix, text_matrix


def _violin_with_heatmap_figure(data, x_col, value_col, title, trace_name, axis_label, name_prefix, x_order=None):
    """Violin plot of `value_col` by `x_col`, with a pairwise-significance
    heatmap inset. Shared by create_pgen_tabs and
    create_distance_tabs_with_heatmap (identical except for which column/
    labels they plot)."""
    unique_cats = data[x_col].unique()
    unique_cats = [x for x in x_order if x in unique_cats] if x_order else sorted(unique_cats)

    p_matrix, text_matrix = _pairwise_significance_matrix(data, x_col, value_col, unique_cats)

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=1, cols=2, column_widths=[0.6, 0.4], horizontal_spacing=0.15,
        specs=[[{"type": "xy"}, {"type": "heatmap"}]]
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Violin(
            x=data[x_col], y=data[value_col], box_visible=True, points=False,
            line_color='#1f77b4', opacity=0.6, name=trace_name, showlegend=False,
            width=0.7, spanmode='hard'
        ), row=1, col=1
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Heatmap(
            z=p_matrix, x=unique_cats, y=unique_cats, text=text_matrix,
            texttemplate="%{text}", textfont={"size": 8}, colorscale="Reds",
            zmin=0, zmax=5, showscale=True,
            colorbar=dict(title="-log10(p)", titleside="top", orientation="v", thickness=10, len=0.5, x=1.1, y=0.5),
            hovertemplate="<b>%{y} vs %{x}</b><br>Sig: %{text}<br>-log10(p): %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>"
        ), row=1, col=2
    )
    fig.update_layout(title=title, width=1000, height=600, plot_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)', margin=dict(t=60, b=100, l=50, r=50))
    fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=-45, row=1, col=1, categoryorder='array', categoryarray=unique_cats)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text=axis_label, row=1, col=1, showgrid=True, gridcolor='lightgrey')
    fig.update_xaxes(showgrid=False, tickangle=-45, tickfont=dict(size=8), row=1, col=2, categoryorder='array', categoryarray=unique_cats)
    fig.update_yaxes(showgrid=False, tickfont=dict(size=8), side="left", row=1, col=2, categoryorder='array', categoryarray=unique_cats)

    title_slug = "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "_" for c in title).strip("_").lower()
    rt_show_wide(fig)


def _violin_with_heatmap_dropdown(pat_df, title_prefix, value_col, trace_name, axis_label, name_prefix, origin_col):
    """Same as _violin_with_heatmap_figure, but with an origin dropdown when
    a patient has more than one origin. Shared by create_pgen_tabs and
    create_distance_tabs_with_heatmap."""
    if origin_col not in pat_df.columns:
        _violin_with_heatmap_figure(pat_df, alias_col, value_col, title_prefix, trace_name, axis_label, name_prefix)
        return

    origins = sorted(pat_df[origin_col].dropna().unique())
    if len(origins) == 0:
        return
    elif len(origins) == 1:
        _violin_with_heatmap_figure(pat_df, alias_col, value_col, f"{title_prefix} ({origins[0]})", trace_name, axis_label, name_prefix)
        return

    processed_origins = []
    for origin in origins:
        origin_df = pat_df[pat_df[origin_col] == origin].copy()
        if timepoint_order_col in origin_df.columns:
            origin_df = origin_df.sort_values(timepoint_order_col)

        unique_cats = origin_df[alias_col].unique().tolist()
        if len(unique_cats) < 1:
            continue

        p_matrix, text_matrix = _pairwise_significance_matrix(origin_df, alias_col, value_col, unique_cats)
        processed_origins.append({
            'origin': origin, 'df': origin_df, 'cats': unique_cats,
            'p_matrix': p_matrix, 'text_matrix': text_matrix
        })

    if not processed_origins:
        return

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=1, cols=2, column_widths=[0.6, 0.4], horizontal_spacing=0.15,
        specs=[[{"type": "xy"}, {"type": "heatmap"}]]
    )

    buttons = []
    initial_cats = processed_origins[0]['cats']

    for i, data in enumerate(processed_origins):
        is_first = (i == 0)
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Violin(
                x=data['df'][alias_col], y=data['df'][value_col],
                box_visible=True, points=False, line_color='#1f77b4', opacity=0.6,
                name=trace_name, showlegend=False, width=0.7, spanmode='hard', visible=is_first
            ), row=1, col=1
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Heatmap(
                z=data['p_matrix'], x=data['cats'], y=data['cats'], text=data['text_matrix'],
                texttemplate="%{text}", textfont={"size": 8}, colorscale="Reds", zmin=0, zmax=5, showscale=True,
                colorbar=dict(title="-log10(p)", titleside="top", orientation="v", thickness=10, len=0.5, x=1.1, y=0.5),
                hovertemplate="<b>%{y} vs %{x}</b><br>Sig: %{text}<br>-log10(p): %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>", visible=is_first
            ), row=1, col=2
        )

        visibility = [False] * (len(processed_origins) * 2)
        visibility[i * 2] = True
        visibility[i * 2 + 1] = True

        buttons.append(dict(
            label=str(data['origin']), method="update",
            args=[
                {"visible": visibility},
                {
                    "title.text": f"{title_prefix} ({data['origin']})",
                    "xaxis.categoryarray": data['cats'],
                    "xaxis2.categoryarray": data['cats'],
                    "yaxis2.categoryarray": data['cats']
                }
            ]
        ))

    fig.update_layout(
        title_text=f"{title_prefix} ({processed_origins[0]['origin']})",
        width=1000, height=600, plot_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',
        margin=dict(t=120, b=100, l=50, r=50),
        updatemenus=[dict(
            active=0, buttons=buttons, x=0.0, xanchor="left", y=1.15, yanchor="top", pad={"r": 10, "t": 10}
        )]
    )
    fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=-45, row=1, col=1, categoryorder='array', categoryarray=initial_cats)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text=axis_label, row=1, col=1, showgrid=True, gridcolor='lightgrey')
    fig.update_xaxes(showgrid=False, tickangle=-45, tickfont=dict(size=8), row=1, col=2, categoryorder='array', categoryarray=initial_cats)
    fig.update_yaxes(showgrid=False, tickfont=dict(size=8), side="left", row=1, col=2, categoryorder='array', categoryarray=initial_cats)

    prefix_slug = "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "_" for c in title_prefix).strip("_").lower()
    rt_show_wide(fig)
